+package trafficpolicy
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"slices"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	envoyroutev3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/config/route/v3"
+	envoy_type_matcher_v3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/type/matcher/v3"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/durationpb"
+
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway"
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/pkg/utils/regexutils"
+)
+
+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	disable         *bool
+	headers         []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader
+	cookies         []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie
+	queryParameters []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter
+	filterState     []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState
+	sourceIP        *kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP
+
+	hashPolicies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherCH, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil && otherCH == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherCH == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+
+	if !ptrEqual(c.disable, otherCH.disable) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if len(c.hashPolicies) != len(otherCH.hashPolicies) {
+		return false
+	}
+	for i := range c.hashPolicies {
+		if !proto.Equal(c.hashPolicies[i], otherCH.hashPolicies[i]) {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func ptrEqual[T comparable](a, b *T) bool {
+	if a == nil && b == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	if a == nil || b == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	return *a == *b
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	if c.disable != nil && *c.disable {
+		if len(c.headers) > 0 || len(c.cookies) > 0 || len(c.queryParameters) > 0 || len(c.filterState) > 0 || c.sourceIP != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("when disable is true, no other fields may be set")
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	for _, h := range c.headers {
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.RegexRewrite.Pattern); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern in header %q: %w", h.HeaderName, err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	for _, ck := range c.cookies {
+		if ck.TTL != nil && *ck.TTL != "" {
+			if _, err := parseCookieTTL(*ck.TTL); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid ttl in cookie %q: %w", ck.Name, err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	for _, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+		if err := hp.ValidateAll(); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Clone() *consistentHashIR {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	clone := &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:         c.disable,
+		headers:         slices.Clone(c.headers),
+		cookies:         slices.Clone(c.cookies),
+		queryParameters: slices.Clone(c.queryParameters),
+		filterState:     slices.Clone(c.filterState),
+	}
+	if c.sourceIP != nil {
+		clone.sourceIP = &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{
+			Terminal: c.sourceIP.Terminal,
+		}
+	}
+	if c.hashPolicies != nil {

+		for i, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+			clone.hashPolicies[i] = proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy)
+		}
+	}
+	return clone
+}
+
+func parseCookieTTL(ttlStr string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(ttlStr)
+	if d, err := time.ParseDuration(trimmed); err == nil {
+		if d < 0 {
+			return 0, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl must be non-negative: %s", ttlStr)
+		}
+		return d, nil
+	}
+	if s, err := strconv.ParseInt(trimmed, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if s < 0 {
+			return 0, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl must be non-negative: %s", ttlStr)
+		}
+		return time.Duration(s) * time.Second, nil
+	}
+	return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: must be Go duration or integer seconds", ttlStr)
+}
+
+func deduplicateHeaders(headers []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader) []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader {
+	if len(headers) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(headers))
+	result := make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader, 0, len(headers))
+	for _, h := range headers {
+		key := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+		if _, exists := seen[key]; !exists {
+			seen[key] = struct{}{}
+			result = append(result, h)

+func (c *consistentHashIR) buildHashPolicies() ([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, error) {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+	if c.disable != nil && *c.disable {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+
+	headers := deduplicateHeaders(c.headers)
+	cookies := deduplicateCookies(c.cookies)
+	queryParams := deduplicateQueryParams(c.queryParameters)
+	filterStates := deduplicateFilterState(c.filterState)
+
+	// If no sub-fields are specified, default to a single sourceIp hash policy with terminal=false
+	if len(headers) == 0 && len(cookies) == 0 && len(queryParams) == 0 && len(filterStates) == 0 && c.sourceIP == nil {
+		return []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			{
+				Terminal: false,
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+					ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+						SourceIp: true,
+					},
+				},
+			},
+		}, nil
+	}
+
+	var policies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	// 1. Headers
+	for _, h := range headers {
+		headerProto := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+			HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			headerProto.RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+				Header: headerProto,
+			},
+		}
+		if h.Terminal != nil {
+			hp.Terminal = *h.Terminal
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 2. Cookies
+	for _, ck := range cookies {
+		cookieProto := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+			Name: ck.Name,
+		}
+		if ck.Path != nil {
+			cookieProto.Path = *ck.Path
+		}
+		if ck.TTL != nil && *ck.TTL != "" {
+			d, err := parseCookieTTL(*ck.TTL)
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, err
+			}
+			cookieProto.Ttl = durationpb.New(d)
+		}
+		if len(ck.Attributes) > 0 {
+			cookieProto.Attributes = make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, len(ck.Attributes))
+			for i, attr := range ck.Attributes {
+				cookieProto.Attributes[i] = &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+					Name:  attr.Name,
+					Value: attr.Value,
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+				Cookie: cookieProto,
+			},
+		}
+		if ck.Terminal != nil {
+			hp.Terminal = *ck.Terminal
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 3. Query Parameters
+	for _, qp := range queryParams {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: qp.Name,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		if qp.Terminal != nil {
+			hp.Terminal = *qp.Terminal
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 4. Filter State
+	for _, fs := range filterStates {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: fs.Key,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		if fs.Terminal != nil {
+			hp.Terminal = *fs.Terminal
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 5. Source IP
+	if c.sourceIP != nil {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		if c.sourceIP.Terminal != nil {
+			hp.Terminal = *c.sourceIP.Terminal
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	return policies, nil
+}

+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+
+	// If disable is true, no other fields may be set
+	if ch.Disable != nil && *ch.Disable {
+		if len(ch.Headers) > 0 || len(ch.Cookies) > 0 || len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 || len(ch.FilterState) > 0 || ch.SourceIP != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("when disable is true, no other fields may be set")
+		}
+		out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			disable: ch.Disable,
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	// Validate cookie TTL and regex patterns during construction
+	for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.RegexRewrite.Pattern); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern in consistent hash header %q: %w", h.HeaderName, err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	for _, ck := range ch.Cookies {
+		if ck.TTL != nil && *ck.TTL != "" {
+			if _, err := parseCookieTTL(*ck.TTL); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid ttl in consistent hash cookie %q: %w", ck.Name, err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	ir := &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:         ch.Disable,
+		headers:         deduplicateHeaders(ch.Headers),
+		cookies:         deduplicateCookies(ch.Cookies),
+		queryParameters: deduplicateQueryParams(ch.QueryParameters),
+		filterState:     deduplicateFilterState(ch.FilterState),
+	}
+	if ch.SourceIP != nil {
+		ir.sourceIP = &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{
+			Terminal: ch.SourceIP.Terminal,
+		}
+	}
+
+	hps, err := ir.buildHashPolicies()
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	ir.hashPolicies = hps
+
+	out.consistentHash = ir
+	return nil
+}
+
+func applyConsistentHash(ir *consistentHashIR, route *envoyroutev3.Route) {
+	if ir == nil || route == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	action := route.GetRoute()
+	if action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if ir.disable != nil && *ir.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+
+	action.HashPolicy = ir.hashPolicies
+}

+func mergeConsistentHash(
+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	opts policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	_ TrafficPolicyMergeOpts,
+) {
+	if p1.spec.consistentHash == nil && p2.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if p1.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = p2.spec.consistentHash.Clone()
+		mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}
+
+	if p2.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	// Both are non-nil. Determine higher and lower priority.
+	var higher, lower *consistentHashIR
+	var higherIsP2 bool
+	if opts.Strategy == policy.OverridableDeepMerge || opts.Strategy == policy.OverridableShallowMerge {
+		higher = p2.spec.consistentHash
+		lower = p1.spec.consistentHash
+		higherIsP2 = true
+	} else {
+		higher = p1.spec.consistentHash
+		lower = p2.spec.consistentHash
+		higherIsP2 = false
+	}
+
+	// If higher-priority policy has disable true:
+	// "When disable is true, no hash policies are produced and any inherited from broader-scoped policies are suppressed."
+	if higher.disable != nil && *higher.disable {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			disable: ptr.To(true),
+		}
+		if higherIsP2 {
+			mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		}
+		return
+	}
+
+	// If lower-priority policy has disable true, it is suppressed by the higher-priority policy.
+	if lower.disable != nil && *lower.disable {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = higher.Clone()
+		if higherIsP2 {
+			mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		}
+		return
+	}
+
+	// Union array fields with higher-priority policy's entries first, deduplicated by key.
+	mergedHeaders := deduplicateHeaders(append(slices.Clone(higher.headers), lower.headers...))
+	mergedCookies := deduplicateCookies(append(slices.Clone(higher.cookies), lower.cookies...))
+	mergedQueryParams := deduplicateQueryParams(append(slices.Clone(higher.queryParameters), lower.queryParameters...))
+	mergedFilterState := deduplicateFilterState(append(slices.Clone(higher.filterState), lower.filterState...))
+
+	// The sourceIp scalar retains the higher-priority policy's value even when unset.
+	var mergedSourceIP *kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP
+	if higher.sourceIP != nil {
+		mergedSourceIP = &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{
+			Terminal: higher.sourceIP.Terminal,
+		}
+	}
+
+	merged := &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:         higher.disable,
+		headers:         mergedHeaders,
+		cookies:         mergedCookies,
+		queryParameters: mergedQueryParams,
+		filterState:     mergedFilterState,
+		sourceIP:        mergedSourceIP,
+	}
+
+	// Build hash policies (built in canonical type order)
+	hps, err := merged.buildHashPolicies()
+	if err == nil {
+		merged.hashPolicies = hps
+	}
+	p1.spec.consistentHash = merged
+
+	// Merge metadata must record this field as consistentHash under the existing TrafficPolicy merge metadata key.
+	mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+}
